cli.help:
ruleprism {version} - which agent instruction files apply to a file, in what order and why

Usage:
  ruleprism which <file>             List the rule files each agent attaches to <file>
  ruleprism explain <pattern> <file> Show how one glob pattern matches <file> in each tool
  ruleprism lint                     Report rule files that silently fail (RP001-RP010)
  ruleprism check <expect.json|yaml> Assert expected rule files per file (for CI)
  ruleprism demo [--write <dir>]     Run on the bundled practice workspace, or write it to <dir>

Options:
  --root <dir>            Workspace root (default: current folder)
  --launch-dir <dir>      Assumed folder the agent was started in, relative to the root (default: the root)
  --agent <list>          claude,copilot,cursor,codex,gemini or all (default: all)
  --json                  Print JSON (schemaVersion 1)
  --user                  Include user-level files (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.gemini)
  --example <name>        Use a bundled practice workspace instead of --root (mixed-monorepo, clean-repo)
  --fail-on <level>       lint: exit 1 at this severity or above: error, warning, info, none (default: warning)
  --claude-instruction-files <mode>  claude-md-or-agents-md (default) or claude-md-and-agents-md
  --codex-max-bytes <n>   Codex total byte limit (default: 32768)
  --lang <en|ko>          Output language (default: RULEPRISM_LANG, then LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG)
  -h, --help              Show this help
  -v, --version           Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 check failed or lint found problems, 2 usage or input error.
Results follow each tool's documentation as of 2026-11-14; they are not observed from a running agent.
